table.title: Equivalent R and SPSS syntax
rows:
df <- read.csv("review-survey.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE, na.strings = c('', 'NA', 'null', 'NULL'))
price <- as.numeric(df$price)
buy_raw <- df$buy
buy <- if (is.numeric(buy_raw)) as.numeric(buy_raw) > 0 else tolower(as.character(buy_raw)) %in% c('1','yes','true','y')
ok <- is.finite(price)
price <- price[ok]; buy <- buy[ok]
agg <- aggregate(buy ~ price, FUN=mean)
rev <- agg$price * agg$buy
cat(sprintf('n=%.16g\n', length(price)))
cat(sprintf('best_price=%.16g\n', agg$price[which.max(rev)]))
